implementation.summary: D29 adds candidate-bound real local HTTP/SQLite/DuckDB/Parquet evidence for semantic model listing and query, dashboard execution and limits, deterministic semantic Bundle export/plan/import, workspace isolation and restart recovery. The journey uses the existing local composition without provider mocks.

security_and_recovery.semantic_identity: The dashboard result is compared with an independent Parquet fixture; the HTTP query and dashboard paths return the expected grouped values and typed columns after the SQLite semantic definitions are loaded.
security_and_recovery.negative_paths: A 13-tile dashboard is rejected with HTTP 400 before execution; a mismatched Bundle digest is rejected with HTTP 400; an unknown workspace receives HTTP 403.
security_and_recovery.bundle_integrity: The exported archive digest and size are recomputed from returned bytes, the reviewed plan is imported into a separate project scope, and the imported model survives restart.
security_and_recovery.workspace_scope: The real local composition returns HTTP 403 for semantic model reads from an unknown workspace; exercised routes use the configured bearer token and workspace-scoped authorizer.
security_and_recovery.provider_scope: Only the local SQLite semantic store, local DuckDB SQL engine and local Parquet fixture were exercised. PostgreSQL semantic persistence, external warehouse/provider serving, cancellation/fan-out operational rehearsal and complete P10 certification were not run and are not claimed.
